problems_model: The photo is dim and the main menu is small. It is a set menu (SF Restaurant Week) with no individual prices. The italic wine pairing lines under each dish were not recorded as items. A larger menu at the top of the photo and a card at the right edge are upside down or cut off, so they were ignored. The TALEGGIO SCARPINOCCI name may be misread as printed, and the two dishes in that group (Taleggio Scarpinocc and Strozzapreti) sit close together, so they may be a choice of pasta course.
